The address answered, but it is not a repository Yomira can read: it needs repo.json and index.min.json in the same folder.

This address is a store-v2 index, the format used by newer Aniyomi builds, which Yomira does not read. Use the index.min.json address of the same repository (for Rede: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyraEz/Rede/repo/index.min.json).

Bulges the centre like a magnifying lens. Ultra only.
Rainbow fringe on small round buttons. Ultra only.
Live blur needs Android 12 and refraction needs Android 13. On older phones, or with quality Off, overlays are drawn as translucent surfaces with no extra cost.
Recommended for this phone: off. It does not have the headroom to run Anime4K without dropping frames.
For HD anime (720p/1080p) that looks blurry or blocky: cleans compression artefacts and sharpens the lines.
For HD anime with only light blur: a softer restore that keeps the original line art.
For low-resolution or noisy video (480p and below): removes noise and enlarges. The lightest mode.
A stronger A that restores twice. Heavy: flagship phones only.
A stronger B. Heavy: flagship phones only.
For very poor sources: removes noise, then restores. Heavy.
Fast uses the smallest network and costs almost nothing; High looks best but can drop frames on most phones.
Measuring for %1$d s… keep the video playing
Smooth: no dropped frames in %1$d s.
%1$d frames dropped and %2$d late in %3$d s. Switched to a lighter setting; check again.
%1$d frames dropped in %2$d s even at the lightest setting. Anime4K was turned off for smooth playback.
Safe mode is on: glass effects are off
It was turned on from the crash report. Tap to turn it off and restart the screen.
Asks the screen for a refresh rate that fits the video's frame rate (e.g. 24 fps on 120 Hz), removing judder at no cost. Android 11+.
Blends frames to the screen's refresh rate. Smoothest on 60 Hz screens; uses a little more GPU. Applies from the next video.
Simple scaling. Lightest on the GPU, never drops frames, slightly softer picture.
Sharp scaling with clean downscaling. Good picture at a small GPU cost.
Sharpest scaling (Lanczos) with smooth edges. Best picture; for strong phones.
Loads up to two minutes ahead so slow or unstable connections do not pause playback. Uses more memory. Applies from the next video.
How often the glass buttons follow the video. Live updates every screen frame with no delay; lower rates save battery.
